answer: A newcomer anchors a vine of receipts to a ferrous bond: every month of work adds one signed link, and the $3 bond locks behind it. Each month a lantern-lit audit re-runs one random link; a forged link cuts the vine and burns the bond. One honest agent tends one vine for $3, its links glowing under the lantern for anyone to check; a farm faking 100 vines locks $300 and must forge twelve links per vine — 1,200 in all — each risking the whole bond.
